messages.subject: Re: Your order was not completed. Any questions? 😊
messages.text:
I want to order, but it said you dont ship to the United States? What do I do ti get order to me? 

 Tom 

 On Sat, Aug 15, 2026, 9:07 AM Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com> wrote:

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Hi ,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We noticed that you haven't completed your Lasclay purchase, and we'd like to assist you in any way we can ( If you did complete it, please disregard this email ). Is there something that made you hesitate or change your mind? Perhaps it was the shipping fee? We're here to help!

 To complete your order, you can click here: 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Return to my cart (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M032VQ4FYFSRHAN2FQMS0JFQ_0)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 If you don't feel ready to purchase, don't hesitate to reply to this email. Our team is ready to assist you. 

 Perhaps you've already explored our website and are aware of this, but we'd like to remind you that when you purchase a Lasclay product, your positive impact is greater than you might imagine: 

 
 You contribute directly to the protection of monarch butterflies, an endangered species. Milkweed fields in Canada provide them with an ideal Summer habitat and valuable breeding grounds before their great migration back to Mexico, after which our farmers harvest milkweed pods in the fall.
 

 You help reduce the demand for animal-based and oil-based insulation, promoting ethical and sustainable practices. 
 

 You're directly helping the courageous farmers who have embarked on the mission to develop this promising crop and democratize milkweed as a natural industrial material.

 
 If you want to learn more about milkweed (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M032VQ4FYFSRHAN2FQMS0JFQ_1) (the plant we use in our products), and monarch butterflies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M032VQ4FYFSRHAN2FQMS0JFQ_2), our website has dedicated sections about these subjects.

 Again, feel free to reach out to us with any questions or concerns. We're here to chat with you and ensure you have a great experience! 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Warmly,

 Gabriel 

Co-founder

Lasclay

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc.
